title: Watsi on ABC News!
summary: When a group of Ryans came together to help a little boy named Ryan on Watsi, ABC News took notice. This heartwarming story shows how a shared name—and a shared sense of humanity—can forever change a life. Watch the clip and see what generosity in action looks like.
body_markdown:
The world could use a bit of good news these days, and we have one to share.


📺 **Watsi was featured on ABC News!** If you missed it,[watch the clip here](https://www.facebook.com/ABCWorldNewsNow/videos/940738811293159/) . Thank you to all *"The Ryans"* who made this moment possible for our[little Ryan](https://watsi.org/profile/a6e31ce9cb40-ryan?ref=watsi.org) .


Snapshot from an ABC News segment featuring a community fundraising for young Ryan on Watsi.


The Ryans reminded us that generosity, when shared, multiplies. Even a small donation on Watsi makes a world of difference. With the power of technology and the magic of human connection—as simple as a shared name—we can ensure[everyone, everywhere](https://watsi.org/fund-treatments?ref=watsi.org) , gets the care they need to thrive. ✨


Little Ryan at home with his mother after surgery supported by Ryans from around the world.
